exercise.title: A fast pentatonic run, to the top
exercise.why: The run keeps its notes on every pass while the key climbs, so what you hear changing is your voice: how many passes stay clear before the top.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the run: two chords set the key, and the mic starts with them. The run goes from Mi up to the high Do and down to the La under Do, four notes per beat. Each pass starts a semitone higher, and the last one reaches the top of your range.
Sing it lightly on "ah", and notice how far up the passes stay clear.
